title: Permutation from a stable pass
statement: Let $\pi,\pi'$ be lists of natural numbers and let $k$ assign a natural-number key to each natural number. Suppose $\pi'$ has the same length as $\pi$ and, for every index $j$ within $\pi$, its entry at position $r_j$ is $\pi_j$, where $r_j$ is the number of entries of $\pi$ with key strictly less than the key of $\pi_j$, plus the number of occurrences of that same key among the entries before position $j$. Then $\pi'$ is a permutation of $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: A key function from natural numbers to natural numbers
